{{Quote|Juggernaut One has been hit. ''[&hellip;]'' Cam out; telemetry data &hellip; it's still moving, but just barely. Another hit like that and it'll be as dead in the mud as Juggernaut Nine.|General Tasse|<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />}}
'''Juggernaut Nine''' was a [[juggernaut]] which served the [[Empire of the Hand]] coalition.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" /> In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">The events of ''[[Crisis of Faith]]'' take place in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]] according to ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''.</ref> it participated in a [[Attack on the Red City|battle]] alongside several other juggernauts against the forces of the [[Storm-hair|alien]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]] and the [[Quesoth]] [[Species/Legends|species]] on the<ref name="Crisis of Faith" /> [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} — Based on corresponding data for [[Quethold system/Legends|Quethold system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quethold]]'s [[Red City]]. While traversing the [[Setting Sun Avenue]], the vehicle was slowed down by [[Quesoth Soldier]]s and Esva's [[Soldier/Legends|warriors]], the [[Chosen (Nuso Esva)|Chosen]]. Shortly after, Imperial [[General/Legends|General]] [[Tasse]] compared Juggernaut Nine's condition to [[Juggernaut One]]'s, which if hit once more would be in the same condition as Nine<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />

Soon after, the Chosen and Soldiers infiltrated the juggernauts present in an attempt to capture them and their [[Weapon/Legends|weaponry]] to attack the nearby [[White City]]; however, they discovered that the juggernauts, including Juggernaut Nine, carried no weapons and were crewed by [[Droid/Legends|droids]].<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />

==Behind the scenes==
Juggernaut Nine appeared in the novella ''[[Crisis of Faith]]'', written by [[Timothy Zahn]] and published in [[2011]] as part of the [[Heir to the Empire: The 20th Anniversary Edition|20th Anniversary Edition]] of the [[1991]] novel ''[[Heir to the Empire]]''.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />
